title: Haj 2026 arrangements and contingency plans amid Middle East uncertainty
asked: Dr Wan Rizal asked for the current status of this year's haj arrangements for Singapore pilgrims and what contingency plans are in place to safeguard and support pilgrims if the situation in the Middle East deteriorates further.
answered_by: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
response: Preparations for Haj 2026 are proceeding as planned. MUIS is in close contact with Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Hajj and Umrah, working with AMTAS and appointed travel agents, and using direct flights, less disruption-prone ground transport and closer coordination of pilgrim movements in Madinah, Makkah and Jeddah. It is developing contingency plans for travel disruptions and unforeseen incidents, with pilgrim safety and welfare as the priority. On the supplementary questions, affected pilgrims will be given priority subject to Saudi Arabia's annual quota, and MUIS will work with AMTAS on deferment to later haj seasons and explore possible refunds.
